S48.01.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.01.note: The button only appears when the message box is empty and voice mode is available; the voice bar opens in the same chat (id is passed in chat/[id].tsx).
steps: Sign in and open an existing chat from the chat list.
Leave the message box empty and find the round button on the right of the composer.
Tap the button labelled "Start voice mode".
Look for the voice bar with the status "Listening" or "Connecting live voice..." and the "End live voice" button, and confirm it is the chat you opened.
S48.01.where: Chat screen with an existing chat open > composer button "Start voice mode" (shown when the message box is empty)

S48.02.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.02.note: The new chat is created with the title "Voice chat" in app/(app)/(tabs)/chat.tsx when the live path is used; the tab's visible name was not found in the code, so the tester should look for the first tab.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat so the message box is empty.
Tap the button labelled "Start voice mode" on the right of the composer.
If the first-time intro appears, tap "Continue" and then "Start voice".
Look for the app moving to a chat that is created for the voice session, with the voice bar showing "Connecting live voice..." or "Listening".
S48.02.where: Chat screen (new chat, no conversation open) > composer button "Start voice mode"

S48.03.needs: a signed-in account, a microphone, and a speaker
S48.03.note: The spoken turns are shown in the voice bar's own transcript; the code did not show them appearing in the normal message list, so check that too.
steps: Open a chat and tap "Start voice mode" in the composer.
Tap "Show captions" in the top bar of the voice view.
Say something and wait for a reply.
Check that the spoken turns appear in a transcript above the voice orb, under the labels "YOU" and "AGI", and compare with Expected.
S48.03.where: Chat screen > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "Show captions"

S48.04.needs: a phone with on-device speech recognition and a microphone
S48.04.note: The route to Settings from the first screen after sign-in was not found in the code, so the tester has to find the Settings screen first.
steps: Open Settings and tap "Voice".
Tap "Open Voice Companion" (this row only appears on phones that have on-device speech recognition).
Look for a full-screen view with a large orb, the text "Tap to speak" and "Speech stays on this device", and a close button.
Compare with Expected: voice fills the screen and no transcript is shown.

S48.05.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.05.note: The status text in the live voice bar has no live-region setting in the code, so whether a screen reader announces it was not confirmed; the full-screen companion does announce "Listening...".
steps: Open a chat and tap "Start voice mode".
Wait for the connection to finish.
Read the status text under the orb.
Check it shows "Listening" and compare with Expected.
S48.05.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > status text under the orb

labels.text: Speaking, talk any time to interrupt

S48.06.needs: a signed-in account, a microphone, and a speaker
steps: Start voice mode in a chat and ask a question that gets a spoken answer.
While the reply is being spoken, read the status text under the orb.
Check it shows "Speaking, talk any time to interrupt" and that the orb moves.
Compare with Expected.
S48.06.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > status text under the orb while the reply plays

S48.07.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.07.note: Tool-specific wording comes from the server; the fallback is "Working on it" in src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceSession.ts.
steps: Start voice mode in a chat and ask for something that needs work, such as a lookup.
While the assistant is working, look at the step with the text "Working on your request" under the status area.
Check that the "Stop the task" button appears next to it.
Compare with Expected.
S48.07.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > ask for a task > "Working on your request"

S48.08.note: In the live voice bar the orb gets a fixed level (0.6) while the assistant speaks and 0 otherwise, so it does not follow the microphone level there.
steps: Open Settings > Voice > "Open Voice Companion".
Speak and watch the orb while you talk.
Then wait for the reply and watch the orb while it speaks.
Compare with Expected: the orb should follow the sound level, not a fixed pattern.
S48.08.where: Settings > Voice > "Open Voice Companion" (full-screen orb) ; also the orb in "Start voice mode" view

labels.text: Muted, tap the mic to talk

S48.09.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
steps: Start voice mode and wait for "Listening".
Tap the button labelled "Mute microphone".
Check the status changes to "Muted, tap the mic to talk" and the button now reads "Unmute microphone".
Tap "Unmute microphone" and check the call is still running (the voice bar stays open).
S48.09.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "Mute microphone" button (bottom right)

S48.10.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.10.note: Usage settling is not visible on screen, so the tester cannot confirm it from the UI.
steps: Start voice mode and wait for "Listening".
Tap the round button labelled "End live voice".
Check the voice bar closes and you are back at the chat.
Check that the chat shows no further voice activity (the session has ended).
S48.10.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "End live voice" button (X, bottom right)

S48.12.needs: a phone with on-device speech recognition and a microphone
S48.12.note: The live voice bar in chat has no push-to-talk behaviour in the code; the setting applies to the full-screen Voice Companion.
steps: Open Settings > Voice and under "Mode" tap "Push to talk".
Go back and tap "Open Voice Companion".
Check the orb hint "Hold to talk, release to send" and the status "Hold to talk".
Press and hold the orb, speak, release, and check the message is sent only after release.
S48.12.where: Settings > Voice > Mode > "Push to talk"; then Settings > Voice > "Open Voice Companion"

S48.13.needs: a phone with on-device speech recognition and a microphone
S48.13.note: The orb hint in the companion reads "Tap to start or stop listening" in hands-free mode, which may be confusing next to the expected automatic listening.
steps: Open Settings > Voice and under "Mode" tap "Hands free".
Go back and tap "Open Voice Companion".
Speak, wait for the reply, and speak again without pressing the orb.
Check the app listens again on its own and compare with Expected.
S48.13.where: Settings > Voice > Mode > "Hands free"; then Settings > Voice > "Open Voice Companion"

labels.text: Speaking, talk any time to interrupt

S48.14.needs: a microphone, a speaker, and a signed-in account (the live voice service)
S48.14.note: Barge-in is marked unverified in the plan and depends on the live service; the code was not run.
steps: Start voice mode and ask a question with a long spoken answer.
While the reply is speaking, say something new.
Check the status changes to "Go ahead" and the reply stops.
Compare with Expected.
S48.14.where: Chat > "Start voice mode" > speak while the reply is playing

S48.15.needs: a phone with the voices available and a microphone
S48.15.note: The voice picker sheet with "Start voice" appears in the first-time voice intro; the voices also have a "Voice mode" list in Settings.
steps: Open Settings > Voice and tap the row "Voice".
On the "Voice & Language" screen, find the group "Voice mode".
Tap a different voice and go back.
Start voice mode in a chat and check the conversation speaks with the chosen voice.
S48.15.where: Settings > Voice > "Voice" > "Voice & Language" > "Voice mode" (list of voices)

S48.16.needs: a microphone is not needed; a speaker and a phone that has not yet seen the voice intro
S48.16.note: The plan says the sample files are not yet committed, so Play sample may do nothing; the code reads them from the sample map and falls back to none.
steps: Use "Start voice mode" in a chat (the first-time intro appears only the first time).
Tap "Continue" on the intro, then select a voice in the picker.
Tap "Play sample" under the voice.
Listen and compare with Expected: a sample of the chosen voice plays.
S48.16.where: Chat > "Start voice mode" > first-time intro "Continue" > voice picker sheet > "Play sample"

steps: Open Settings > Voice and tap "Speech language".
Pick a language from the list (the first choice is "Uses your device language").
Go back and start voice mode in a chat.
Speak in the chosen language and check the app understands it.

S48.21.needs: a signed-in account, a microphone, and a speaker
S48.21.note: The captions panel only shows when there are turns to show.
steps: Start voice mode and have a short exchange.
Tap "Show captions" in the top bar.
Check a transcript appears with the labels "YOU" and "AGI" for both speakers.
Tap "Hide captions" and check the transcript goes away.
S48.21.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "Show captions" (top bar of the voice view)

S48.22.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
S48.22.note: Whether the turns are saved into the chat message store was not confirmed in this audit (the store reference was not read).
steps: Start voice mode, turn on "Show captions", and have a short exchange.
Tap "End live voice".
Look at the chat and check the spoken turns are kept with it.
Compare with Expected.
S48.22.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "Show captions"; then check the chat after ending

S48.26.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone
steps: Start voice mode in a chat.
Ask for something that uses a tool (for example a lookup or an image).
When the result comes back, look for the section "What the actions returned" in the voice view.
Check the tool name, output and any image are shown.
S48.26.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > ask for an action > "What the actions returned"

S48.27.needs: a signed-in account and a microphone; an action that needs approval
S48.27.note: The button text is taken from TOOL_APPROVAL_ACTION_LABELS; the rendered text itself was not read, so check the visible words on screen.
steps: Start voice mode and ask for an action that needs your approval.
Look for the panel with the title "Waiting for your approval" and the summary of the action.
Tap "Allow" or "Deny" without leaving the voice view.
Check the request continues or stops and compare with Expected.
S48.27.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > ask for an action that needs approval > "Waiting for your approval" > "Allow" or "Deny"

S48.36.needs: a phone you can switch networks on and off, a signed-in account
S48.36.note: The message for a dropped connection is "The live voice connection dropped." in src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceAvailability.ts; the exact retry wording after failure was not fully traced.
steps: Start voice mode and wait for "Listening".
Turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data (or Airplane Mode) for a few seconds.
Look for the status "Reconnecting live voice...".
Turn the network back on and check the status returns to "Listening", or check for the error box with "Try again" if it does not reconnect.
S48.36.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > turn off Wi-Fi or mobile data > "Reconnecting live voice..."

S48.37.needs: a signed-in account whose voice usage is used up
S48.37.note: The limit sentence comes from the server (extendLiveVoiceSession in src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceSession.ts); the app shows whatever the server sends.
steps: Use up the voice allowance on the account (or use an account that has none left).
Tap "Start voice mode" in a chat.
Look for the error box in the voice view with a message that names the limit and when it resets.
Check the buttons "Try again" and "Use the keyboard" are shown.
S48.37.where: Chat > "Start voice mode" when the plan's voice allowance is used up > error box in the voice view

steps: Start voice mode in a chat.
Tap the bar labelled "Type instead" at the bottom left.
Check the voice view closes and the message box is ready to type in.
Type a message and send it, and check it continues the same chat.
S48.38.where: Chat > open a chat > "Start voice mode" > "Type instead" (bottom left of the voice view)

S48.39.needs: an earlier voice chat and a signed-in account
S48.39.note: The conversation is sent by id (src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceSession.ts); the use of earlier turns is decided by the server and was not traced.
steps: Open a voice chat from earlier (one started by voice).
Tap "Start voice mode" in the composer.
Say something that refers to an earlier turn.
Check the reply uses the earlier context and compare with Expected.
S48.39.where: Chat list > open an earlier voice chat > "Start voice mode" in the composer

labels.text: Stop the task and keep talking

S48.41.needs: a signed-in account, a microphone, and a task that is running
S48.41.note: The button "Stop the task" (aria label "Stop the task and keep talking") in LiveVoiceBar.tsx cancels the task only; no separate on-screen control to stop just the spoken reply was found, so the tester cannot check this part from the UI.
